indicators.label: Population growth
indicators.desc: Change in the number of inhabitants of the osa-alue over one year, %.
indicators.note: Counted for the osa-alue itself, not inherited from the kunta. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. Attribution must name the database and the underlying source — "Helsingin seudun aluesarjat -tilastokanta ja Tilastokeskus" — and must not imply the publisher endorses the use.

indicators.label: Share aged 19–34
indicators.desc: Inhabitants aged 19–34 as a share of all inhabitants. Aluesarjat's published age band is 19–34, one year wider at the bottom than the 20–34 band used at kunta level, so the two are shown as different indicators rather than as one.
indicators.note: Counted for the osa-alue itself, not inherited from the kunta. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. Attribution must name the database and the underlying source — "Helsingin seudun aluesarjat -tilastokanta ja Tilastokeskus" — and must not imply the publisher endorses the use.

indicators.label: Foreign-language speakers
indicators.desc: Inhabitants whose mother tongue is neither Finnish, Sami nor Swedish, as a share of all inhabitants — the same definition as the kunta figure.
indicators.note: Counted for the osa-alue itself, not inherited from the kunta. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. Attribution must name the database and the underlying source — "Helsingin seudun aluesarjat -tilastokanta ja Tilastokeskus" — and must not imply the publisher endorses the use.

indicators.label: One-person households
indicators.desc: One-person household-dwelling units as a share of all households.
indicators.note: Counted for the osa-alue itself, not inherited from the kunta. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. Attribution must name the database and the underlying source — "Helsingin seudun aluesarjat -tilastokanta ja Tilastokeskus" — and must not imply the publisher endorses the use.

indicators.label: Rented dwellings
indicators.desc: Dwellings held on a rental basis — government-subsidised (arava or korkotuki) plus other rented — as a share of all dwellings. The kunta-level figure counts *households living in* a rented dwelling, which is a different thing, so this has its own name.
indicators.note: Counted for the osa-alue itself, not inherited from the kunta. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. Attribution must name the database and the underlying source — "Helsingin seudun aluesarjat -tilastokanta ja Tilastokeskus" — and must not imply the publisher endorses the use.

indicators.label: Dwellings in blocks of flats
indicators.desc: Dwellings in blocks of flats as a share of all dwellings — the same definition as the kunta figure.
indicators.note: Counted for the osa-alue itself, not inherited from the kunta. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. Attribution must name the database and the underlying source — "Helsingin seudun aluesarjat -tilastokanta ja Tilastokeskus" — and must not imply the publisher endorses the use.

indicators.label: Dwellings with no permanent residents
indicators.desc: Dwellings not in permanent occupation as a share of all dwellings — the same definition as the kunta figure.
indicators.note: Counted for the osa-alue itself, not inherited from the kunta. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. Attribution must name the database and the underlying source — "Helsingin seudun aluesarjat -tilastokanta ja Tilastokeskus" — and must not imply the publisher endorses the use.

indicators.label: Tertiary education (15+)
indicators.desc: People with a tertiary degree as a share of everyone aged 15 or over. The kunta-level figure is of everyone aged 18 or over, so the two are shown as different indicators.
indicators.note: Counted for the osa-alue itself, not inherited from the kunta. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. indicators.label: Projected population change 2026→2040
indicators.desc: Helsingin kaupunki's own population projection for the area, from 2026 to 2040. This is the city's forecast, not Tilastokeskus's: the two are different runs with different assumptions and are never combined.
indicators.note: Helsinki only — Espoo and Vantaa publish their own area projections on different vintages and to different end years, which are not shown here rather than being stretched to match. Aluesarjat is open for both non-commercial and commercial use. Attribution must name the database and the underlying source — "Helsingin seudun aluesarjat -tilastokanta ja Tilastokeskus" — and must not imply the publisher endorses the use.
indicators.warn: Helsingin kaupunki's own projection, base alternative PER26. A different run from Tilastokeskus's municipal projection.

proj.caveat: The city's own projection reflects its housing plans as well as births, deaths and migration. It is a scenario, not a promise.
